pending.loadError: Could not load the approval queue
form.title: Title
reject.consequence_one: {{count}} reference will be Rejected and not used as a source. You can reinstate it later.
reject.consequence_other: {{count}} references will be Rejected and not used as sources. You can reinstate them later.
ref.explain.pending: Not reviewed — not used for citations or evidence.
ref.explain.rejected: Rejected — not used as a source.
ref.explain.revoked: Revoked — not used for new citations or evidence.
ref.explain.unavailable: Usable for citations, not for evidence.
ref.explain.failed: Usable for citations; evidence is not available because indexing failed.
ref.explain.indexing: Usable for citations; evidence becomes available when indexing finishes.
ref.edit.title: Edit metadata
ref.edit.conflict: The reference changed elsewhere. It was reloaded; your input is kept so you can redo the edit.
ref.doc.none: No document yet. The reference can still be cited.
ref.usage.title: Used in projects
ref.usage.none: No project uses this reference yet.
revoke.title: Revoke this reference from the Trusted Library?
revoke.consequence: {{projects}} projects use it; {{evidence}} evidence will become Stale and citations to it will report an error.
revoke.done: Revoked. Impact: {{projects}} projects, {{evidence}} evidence became Stale.
delete.title: Delete this reference?
delete.consequence: The reference is removed from the library. No project uses it.
delete.inUse: Not deleted: the reference is used in a project. See Used in projects; revoke it instead.
project.title: Add to project
project.consequence: A Trusted reference is usable in the project right away, without another approval.
merge.title: Merge into another reference
merge.consequence: Choose the reference to keep. This one will point to it and no longer appear on its own.
discover.boundary: Results enter the Trusted Library only after you approve them; nothing is added to a project automatically.
discover.sourcesError: Could not read the source list; searching with the default source.
discover.tab.title: Title
discover.tab.author: Author

discover.error.rateLimited: The source is temporarily limiting access
discover.error.sourceFailed: The source returned an error or asked for verification
discover.error.suggest: Nothing is retried automatically. Search again or import manually.
discover.cancelled: Search cancelled. The query stays in the form.
discover.notFound.title: Search not found
discover.notFound.reason: This search does not exist or is not yours. Search again.
